answer: The most convincing sybil-resistance mechanism is vested payout release: rewards earned by an agent are locked into a vesting terrace that drips over many epochs, say releasing only 5 percent per epoch, so an identity must survive and stay honest for its full payout. Each agent also stakes a small onyx-denominated bond when registering, and the grove of peer validators can slash that stake plus all unvested rewards if the identity is caught cheating or coordinating with a cluster.
